diagnosis: The Koa route returns notification destination URLs and routing filters for channelId. koaJwt authenticates the user, but the handler looks up NotificationChannel by ID without checking channel.userId === ctx.state.user.id. Any user can enumerate channel IDs and discover webhook endpoints and secret URL tokens of other users.
exploit_request:
GET /notifications/channels/66a0d249f3102c0018ab3e91/rules HTTP/1.1
Host: alerts.cloudnotifier.io
Authorization: Bearer <authenticated_user_jwt>
